title: Randomized-base GT transfer, lazy-descent STNFS core of recover-Q 9332a74d (lazy cofactorisation and boot, five-vector Krylov passes, weight-300 merge) with a one-SE descent relation input and complete-orbit unit duplicates: 123.617570069061269

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). It maps T to z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b (exactly the uniform nonidentity-base, independent-target distribution), converts both into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is that of recover-Q 9332a74d: excess 1.1, theta=2330/8000 sub-region of a 164,000-draw pool (retained relations >= 2^63.6617, 2.00 pool SE above 1.1 U), 99.9% ECM, X2=2^64, slacks (295, 226), band strip, f-first early abort, allowance 1.0174: collection <= 2^119.9297 units; Markowitz merge to weight 300, N=2^58.9429, eight owners, Block Wiedemann (30, 5) with five-vector Krylov passes: linear algebra <= 2^117.4615, generator <= 2^108.0375; 62-node descent plan and boot (215, 344, 14, 4), UDUP 0.65 supported by complete unit orbits, lazy cofactorisation and lazy boot (at most 18 relations), with the descent relation input 2^63.624, one relative pool SE below the retained-count estimate: expected two-log work <= 2^115.9591, meter 2^116.698, Markov abort <= 0.59920, boot failure <= 3.874e-03 per log, node counter 2^27.3 (abort <= 2^-8.78), repeats <= 2^-10.70, 2/r charged; upper-rounded core ledger rows sum to 2^120.2941979 <= 2^120.2942 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is at most 10 x (1001/1000) x 2^120.2942 + 2^80/2000 < 2^123.617570069061269 G1 reference units (C=2,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit. {}: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, integration probes, lazy bound vs a simulation, core ledger and success, G1 conversion (80-digit) and base-randomisation bijections. {"descent": true} also re-evaluates the descent recurrence, node counter and success. evidence16.py (local, about 115 s natively, not a hosted experiment) reruns every certificate and check.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) at relation excess 1.1 (default; optional 'excess') to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional. Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
